structured_output.digest_summary: loopwatch v0.2 revival continued in parallel: session 1 (claude-code-1) implemented phases 1–5 of the full spec (cost floor, privacy, two-tier extraction, GitHub source, PR publishing), while session 2 (claude-code-2) isolated and fixed the critical self-ingestion loop where nightly headless runs re-mined their own transcripts. Cost now visible, bounded, and zero on quiet days.
structured_output.highlights:
Implemented loopwatch v0.2 phases 1–5: bundle cap, activity floor, ledger skeleton, redaction + preflight, two-tier triage/extract, GitHub API source, PR publish flow
Identified root cause of cost compounding: claude -p persists sessions under ~/.claude/projects/encoded-cwd/, so tmpdir runs get re-ingested nightly
Three-layer fix for self-ingestion: --no-session-persistence flag, fixed run dir with exclusion patterns, watermark filtering for moved projects
Learned --max-budget-usd enforcement behavior: budget hit returns error and exit 1, requires fail-closed handling (keep watermarks, ledger skip reason)
macOS gotcha discovered: /var symlinks to /private/var, so encoded project dir names differ; suffix matching needed for robust exclusion
Smoke tests now cover bundle cap, self-ingest exclusion, partial-line handling, truncation recovery, hashed state paths

candidates.title: Self-ingestion loop: root cause, three-layer fix, and --max-budget-usd behavior
candidates.why: Non-obvious bug where headless Claude sessions auto-persist under ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/; each night re-mines the previous night's input. Fix involves CLI flag, fixed run dir with pattern matching, and watermark filtering, plus a platform gotcha (macOS /var symlink) and cost enforcement semantics worth preserving.
